summary: Lewis County, WA peak near Morton; a tower built in the 1930s, now gone, with no removal date found and a private gate on the access road.

facts.status_note: Tower gone per FFLOS and FireLookout.com; no removal date or reason found in sources read.

access.note: Route to the summit runs through a private gate on Forest Service Road 71, open at some point during the year; a sign at the gate gives a phone number for access times (Willhite)

events.note: Registered May 26, 2012 as US 1282, WA 182; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 3,415 ft (1,041 m), which Willhite says is likely a Metsker benchmark; he gives the summit as 3,520 ft or more from USGS data and a 1937 Forest Service map. The brief's 1040.9 m matches the register figure, and the story reports both.
Sources agree the tower is gone but none gives a removal date or reason; the 1930s build decade is the only date.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No event is recorded for the 1930s build because no source gives a year (the register and FireLookout.com say only 1930s). No staffing source found; staffing key omitted. Access level 'permission' is an inference from a private gate with a posted phone number for access times; no source says 'permission' outright. Willhite's visit date is not given. The story deliberately gives no route directions to the summit. Register lists agency as Washington Division of Forestry/DNR; Forest Lookouts site says State Department of Forestry. Two WebSearch calls used; the Huckleberry Lookout page surfaced but is a different site and was not used.
